# glyhub <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="glyhub logo" />

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
<!-- badges: end -->

glyhub collects glycomics and glycoproteomics data for the Glycoverse ecosystem,
using the [`GlycomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycomicSE.html)
and [`GlycoproteomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycoproteomicSE.html) containers from
[glyexp](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyexp). The package is experimental.

## Available data

Eleven glycomics objects are bundled from two public studies. No glycoproteomics
datasets are included yet.

| Dataset | Features × observations |
|---|---|
| `glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1` | 9 × 18 |
| `glyhub_GPST000738_N_ST6GAL1` | 10 × 28 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5` | 108 × 22 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S7` | 77 × 6 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B` | 56 × 7 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B` | 9 × 8 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B` | 3 × 8 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C` | 3 × 15 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C` | 2 × 15 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S11B` | 60 × 9 |
| `glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12` | 140 × 4 |

GPST000738 retains both enzyme experiments and all raw-table feature rows.
Conflicting cells are NA; this is not a complete reconstruction of the authors'
final analytical matrix. Flow and time are conditions, and a repeated control
table is represented once per enzyme. Unmatched processed-table observations
remain in metadata without invented sample pairing.

GPST000643 uses complete supplementary quantitative tables for separate
experiments. Tables S10B and S10C have distinct N/O feature spaces and are split accordingly.
Each pair retains the same source observation columns and original denominators. Source labels do not
establish biological replication or cross-table pairing.

**Zero-valued abundances are stored as NA in the distributed assays.**
Original values, source n.d./NA,
conflict masks and zero-to-NA records are retained separately in metadata.
Metadata zeros (such as 0 hours) are unchanged. Measurements are not imputed or
renormalized. Read the [curation audit](data-raw/AUDIT.md) for source selection,
units, annotation precision, licenses and limitations.

## Installation

Install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub):

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub")
```

## Example

```{r}
x <- glyhub::glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1
dim(x)
data.frame(as.list(S4Vectors::metadata(x)$processing_counts))
```

Data use R's LazyData mechanism. `SummarizedExperiment::assay(x)` contains the
curated abundance matrix; `S4Vectors::metadata(x)$raw_abundance` preserves the
unconverted values. `rowData(x)` retains typed glyrepr annotations and source
evidence, and `colData(x)` retains source conditions and observation locations.

## Reproduction

Original inputs and scripts are grouped by accession under `data-raw/GPST000643/`
and `data-raw/GPST000738/`. From the package root:

```r
source("data-raw/build.R")
# Check that rebuilding preserves scientific contents:
source("data-raw/validate-reproduction.R")
```

See [validation results](data-raw/VALIDATION.md). See `?glyhub_data_conventions` for shared measurement and annotation conventions.
